title: Sr UX Designer
description:
About Us Automation Anywhere is the leader in Agentic Process Automation (APA), transforming how work gets done with AI-powered automation. Its APA system, built on the industry s first Process Reasoning Engine (PRE) and specialized AI agents, combines process discovery, RPA, end-to-end orchestration, document processing, and analytics-all delivered with enterprise-grade security and governance. Guided by its vision to fuel the future of work, Automation Anywhere helps organizations worldwide boost productivity, accelerate growth, and unleash human potential. Sr. UX designer Location : Bangalore (Onsite) 
 Exp - 4+ Years 
 
 COME JOIN US 
 
 Exciting opportunity: Automation Anywhere is looking for a Senior UX Designer to join our team. and shape how knowledge workers will adopt and leverage Agentic Process Automation (APA) to transform life, business, and the global economy. 
 Agentic Automation - Position the role around orchestrating AI agents, automation, systems, and human decision-making, not just designing workflows. AI-Native Design - Make AI usage an expectation. We need designers who leverage AI to learn, prototype, and iterate faster while maintaining strong product judgment. Senior Ownership - Emphasize solving ambiguous problems, influencing direction, building systems, and driving experiences from concept to ship, beyond wireframes and mockups. 
 At Automation Anywhere, we believe that people who have time to create, think, and discover build great companies. Our intelligent process robots transform the way businesses operate, delivering complex business and IT work across a range of processes including procure-to-pay, quote-to-cash, HR administration, claims processing, and thousands of other front and back-office processes. 
 
 HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE 
 The job of a Senior User Experience Designer is to envision how people experience our products and bring that vision to life in a way that feels inspired, refined and even magical. In a UX Designer role, you ll take on complex tasks and transform them into intuitive, accessible, and easy-to-use designs for users around the world -ranging from novice to sophisticated users. Achieving this goal requires that you collaborate closely with teams of Designers, Researchers, Engineers, and Product Managers throughout the design process-from crafting user flows and 
 wireframes to building user interface mock-ups and prototypes. At each stage, you will anticipate what our users need, advocate for them, and ensure that the final product surprises and delights them. 
 
 We strive to learn and understand our users needs, behaviours, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, visual designers, and technical designers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products unique capabilities and personalities. 
 
 WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 Storytelling and problem framing for a diverse audience of stakeholders, helping them envision experience opportunities. 
 Articulate user journeys with scenarios, storyboards and presentations, low and high-fidelity mocks, detailed interaction specs, and prototypes to effectively communicate interaction and design ideas. 
 Build strong relationships, influence and partnerships with leaders inside and outside their core product team to efficiently implement user experiences that are cohesive, inclusive, and well-informed. 
 Contribute to UX vision and strategy, generating buy-in and operationalizing the strategy across larger teams and timelines. 
 Raise the bar for product quality across our products by advocating for user cantered product roadmaps, investments in last-mile refinement and polish, and insights driven by user research. 
 
 YOU HAVE 
 4+ years of experience designing and shipping software user experiences. 
 A portfolio of UX-focused work samples for web and mobile applications that demonstrate your design thinking. 
 
 AND 
 Experience collaborating with and influencing Product Management and Engineering counterparts. 
 Experience conducting UX research to amplify research and design impact. 
 Expertise with design tools (e.g., Claude, Figma, etc.) to produce wireframes and high-fidelity mockups. 
 Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
 . Having a Portfolio is mandatory.

 We're looking for a curious, empathetic, and proactive UX Research Intern to help us understand our users and improve their healthcare experiences.
You'll work closely with the Design and Product teams to speak with real users, explore their behaviours, identify pain points, and turn research findings into meaningful product insights.
This role is ideal for someone who loves asking questions, observing human behaviour, challenging assumptions, and understanding the why behind what people do. 
 What you'll do
 Conduct user research: Plan and conduct user interviews, contextual conversations, surveys, and usability testing. Talk to real users: Connect with patients, caregivers, and consumers to understand their healthcare needs, medicine-purchasing habits, and digital experiences. Explore user behaviour: Understand how people discover medicines, evaluate trust, interpret prescriptions, and make healthcare decisions. Identify pain points: Uncover friction, unmet needs, and opportunities across the customer journey. Analyse research findings: Organise qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns, and synthesise insights. Communicate insights: Create research summaries, interview notes, user personas, journey maps, and insight presentations. Collaborate with teams: Work with Product Managers, Designers, and other stakeholders to translate findings into actionable product opportunities. Stay curious: Explore competitor experiences, emerging user behaviours, and new ways to make digital healthcare simpler and more accessible. 
 What we're looking for
 A student, recent graduate, or early-career candidate interested in UX research, human behaviour, psychology, or product discovery. Strong curiosity and empathy, with a genuine interest in understanding people. Excellent listening, communication, and questioning skills. Comfort speaking with unfamiliar people and conducting interviews in person or remotely. Strong observation and analytical skills, with the ability to identify patterns in qualitative feedback. Clear written communication and the ability to present findings in a structured manner. A self-starter who is organised, resourceful, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. 
 Good to have
 Exposure to user research, design thinking, usability testing, or market research. Familiarity with tools such as Google Forms, Google Sheets, Excel, Miro, or Figma. Experience with college research projects, internships, field studies, or independent research. Interest in healthcare, consumer behaviour, accessibility, or digital products. Prior professional experience is not mandatory. Curiosity, empathy, and the ability to learn are more important.
Internship details
 Duration: 6 months Type: Paid internship Work mode: Hybrid Team: Product Design / UX Research Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

description:
Job Summary 
 Scopely is looking for a Senior Technical Artist to join the Royal Lounge Casino team in Bangalore. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and aim to inspire play every day, whether through our work with talented colleagues or through our connection with millions of players around the world. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating within the mobile games industry. With 30M+ downloads, Royal Lounge Casino is home to slots, bingo, cards, and more. Our team is distributed across multiple hubs, including Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, Barcelona, and other global locations. 

 What You ll Do 
 As a Senior Technical Artist, you will focus on converting, integrating, and optimizing existing slot games and legacy assets within our Unity production pipeline. You will work closely with Art, Design, Engineering, QA, and Production to deliver high-quality game content while maintaining visual consistency, mobile performance, and compatibility across supported devices. You will also contribute to improving technical art workflows, resolving integration challenges, and supporting efficient content delivery for our live-service game. Key responsibilities include: Convert and integrate existing slot games and legacy assets into Unity, including UI elements, symbols, backgrounds, animations, VFX, and supporting game screens Adapt and optimize Unity UI layouts, Canvas configurations, prefabs, masking, sorting layers, and asset scaling to ensure visual consistency across supported mobile devices and resolutions Create, edit, integrate, and optimize Spine 2D and Unity animations, ensuring smooth playback, correct layering, and efficient runtime performance Integrate and optimize shaders, materials, visual effects, and other 2D/3D assets while maintaining visual quality and mobile performance requirements Profile and troubleshoot rendering, memory usage, asset loading, animation performance, and runtime efficiency using Unity profiling and debugging tools Support slot game conversions, re-skins, LiveOps events, and regular content releases, including playtesting, bug fixing, visual polish, and production readiness Develop and improve Unity tools, editor extensions, automation scripts, and technical art workflows to reduce manual effort and improve content integration efficiency Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges, document production standards, and share technical knowledge with other Technical Artists 

 What We re Looking For 
 5+ years of experience as a Technical Artist in the game industry, preferably with at least one shipped mobile or console title. Practical experience converting, integrating, or adapting existing game assets into Unity pipelines, including slot games, game re-skins, or comparable content conversion workflows Hands-on expertise in Spine 2D animation, including rigging, skeletons, skins, slots, attachments, atlases, animation states, events, draw order, and Unity runtime integration Strong understanding of Unity UI systems, including Canvas, prefabs, layout management, masking, sorting layers, animation setup, and mobile resolution compatibility Experience integrating and optimizing 2D assets, animations, VFX, shaders, and materials while balancing visual quality with mobile performance constraints Experience profiling and resolving rendering, memory, asset loading, and animation performance issues using Unity Profiler, Frame Debugger, or equivalent tools Ability to independently troubleshoot technical art challenges, maintain production workflows, and contribute practical improvements to asset integration and delivery processes Experience collaborating with Art, Design, Engineering, QA, and Production teams, communicating technical requirements clearly, and sharing knowledge with colleagues 

 Bonus Points 
 Experience supporting slot games, social casino games, or other content-intensive live-service mobile games Experience developing Unity editor tools, custom automation scripts, or reusable technical art solutions Familiarity with Jenkins or similar CI/CD systems, version control, and automated content integration workflows Understanding of Unity Addressables, Asset Bundles, asset packaging, and build processes Experience with advanced 3D content pipelines or additional animation and VFX production workflows Experience using generative AI or AI-assisted tools to improve asset creation, content processing, validation, or production efficiency Experience contributing to technical documentation, pipeline standards, or technical guidance for other artists Please include a portfolio or PDF/links to examples of your work in the application.

title: Senior Creative Designer
description:
Job Description 
 Were looking for a Senior Creative Designer with exceptional visual design skills, strong UI/UX knowledge, and a clear understanding of customer experience (CX). You should be able to turn business goals and customer needs into distinctive, intuitive, and consistent design. This is a hands-on role with opportunities to lead creative direction, mentor designers, and raise the quality of work across the team. We value someone who uses AI thoughtfully, understands its limitations, and brings original thinking and strong design judgment to every project. 
 What youll do: 
 Create high-quality designs for websites, digital products, brand experiences, and marketing initiatives. Set a clear creative direction through strong typography, layout, colour, imagery, and visual storytelling. Translate business requirements, user research, and customer insights into concepts, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces. Consider the complete customer journey, ensuring consistency across discovery, onboarding, product use, and support. Build and evolve design systems that balance brand expression, usability, accessibility, and development feasibility. Collaborate with product managers, developers, marketers, and stakeholders to take designs from concept to implementation. Present design decisions clearly, explain trade-offs, and incorporate feedback with purpose. Lead design reviews, guide project execution, and maintain high standards across team deliverables. Mentor designers through actionable feedback, coaching, and knowledge-sharing. Use AI tools to support exploration and execution while reviewing outputs for originality, relevance, consistency, and usability. 
 What were looking for: 
 A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative craft and thoughtful design across digital experiences. Solid knowledge of UI/UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, responsive design, and accessibility. An understanding of how design influences customer trust, satisfaction, conversion, and retention. Proficiency in Figma and relevant creative tools, with the ability to choose the right tool for the task. The ability to develop original concepts and carry them through to detailed, implementation-ready designs. Practical understanding of AI design limitations, including generic outputs, weak contextual understanding, inconsistent interfaces, and accessibility gaps. Sound judgment about when to use AI, when to refine its output, and when to design independently. Experience leading design work and a genuine willingness to mentor people and help them grow. Strong communication, collaboration, ownership, and attention to detail. Comfort balancing creative ambition with timelines, technical constraints, and business priorities. 
 Good to have: 
 Experience working with clients across different industries. Knowledge of user research, usability testing, customer journey mapping, and service design. Exposure to motion design, illustration, or brand identity. A working understanding of frontend development and design-to-development handoffs. 
 What success looks like: 
 Your work makes experiences visually distinctive and easy to use. You connect creative decisions to customer needs and business goals, help the team deliver consistently strong work, and develop designers who become more capable and independent. 
 When applying: 
 Share your portfolio and two or three projects that explain the problem, your contribution, your design decisions, and the outcome. If you used AI, explain where it helped and where your judgment changed the result. 
 Educational Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Graphic Design, Communication Design, Visual Arts, Interaction Design, UI/UX Design, or a related field. Preferred: B.Des, BFA, M.Des, or equivalent design qualification. Candidates with a degree in Computer Science or a related field may also be considered if they have strong design skills and a relevant portfolio. A strong portfolio and relevant professional experience should carry more weight than the degree alone.

title: Sr. Designer, Brand & Communications
description:
Candescent is seeking a highly skilled Senior Designer to join our Brand Communications team from one of our India office locations. This role will help bring the Candescent brand to life across internal, client-facing, executive, event, digital, and sales enablement materials. The ideal candidate combines strong design craft, production discipline, visual problem-solving, and brand stewardship with the ability to move quickly across a wide range of requests. This is a hands-on design role, not a review-only or coordination role. The Senior Designer will personally create, refine, and finalize high-quality work while partnering closely with brand, communications, marketing, product marketing, sales, events, and executive stakeholders. Success requires excellent judgment, strong typography and layout skills, comfort with content-heavy materials, and the ability to maintain a consistent visual standard across every touchpoint. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Brand Design Visual Execution 
 Create polished visual solutions across digital, print, presentation, event, environmental, sales enablement, and internal communications projects. Design a wide range of assets including executive presentations, sales and marketing decks, one-pagers, ebooks, infographics, newsletters, social graphics, event materials, signage, and internal communications visuals. Translate complex, content-heavy, or abstract information into clear, engaging, and visually compelling communications. Elevate layouts, typography, hierarchy, imagery, icons, charts, and data visualizations so materials are easy to understand and unmistakably on brand. 
 
 Brand Consistency Design Systems 
 Apply and extend Candescent brand standards across all assigned work, including typography, color, layout, iconography, imagery, presentation systems, and data visualization. Help maintain a consistent visual experience across internal and external channels, ensuring work feels connected, professional, and aligned to the company s brand narrative. Use established templates and systems appropriately, while identifying opportunities to improve usability, scalability, and consistency. Spot and correct brand drift, formatting inconsistencies, visual clutter, and production issues before materials are delivered. 
 
 Production, Quality Control Delivery 
 Prepare accurate, production-ready files for digital, print, presentation, large-format, and event applications. Proof work carefully for alignment, spacing, hierarchy, accuracy, pagination, export settings, image quality, and brand compliance. Manage multiple projects and deadlines at once while maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail. Respond quickly to feedback, incorporate revisions thoughtfully, and deliver final assets that require minimal rework. 
 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Partner with Brand Communications team members and cross-functional stakeholders to clarify objectives, understand audiences, and translate business needs into effective visual communications. Collaborate with US-based stakeholders and global team members through clear communication, organized handoffs, and reliable follow-through. Work with agencies, vendors, freelancers, or production partners when needed, providing files, feedback, specifications, and guidance that support high-quality outcomes. Operate with ownership and accountability, knowing when to ask questions, when to recommend a stronger solution, and when to move quickly to execution. 
 
 Experience 
 Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience 7+ years of professional graphic design experience, preferably within an in-house creative team, agency, corporate brand team, B2B, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise environment. Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design execution across presentations, print, digital, sales enablement, events, internal communications, and brand storytelling materials. Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop. Advanced PowerPoint design skills, including executive-level presentations, slide systems, master templates, visual hierarchy, charts, diagrams, and content-heavy storytelling. Strong typography, layout, composition, information design, and visual storytelling skills. Deep understanding of brand systems and how to apply them consistently across multiple channels, audiences, and formats. Strong production knowledge, including file preparation, print production, vendor coordination, export specifications, and large-format applications. Experience turning complex or technical subject matter into clear, polished, visually engaging communications. Proven ability to manage multiple projects, adapt to shifting priorities, and deliver high-quality work on deadline. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly and professionally. 
 
 Qualifications Preferred Distinctions 
 Additional accomplishments Bachelor s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, Fine Arts, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio may be considered in lieu of a formal degree. Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred. Experience designing for executive, client, consultant, partner, or sales audiences is preferred. Experience with Figma, Canva, After Effects, motion graphics, web design, or digital campaign tools is a plus. Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful. 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Brand and communications materials are polished, consistent, accurate, and recognizably Candescent across every touchpoint. Executive, client-facing, sales, and internal materials are visually clear, easy to follow, and delivered with a high level of craft. The Brand Communications team can rely on this role for dependable, hands-on execution with minimal rework. Templates, systems, and recurring materials become easier to use, more consistent, and faster to produce over time. Stakeholders receive thoughtful design partnership, clear communication, and high-quality deliverables on deadline. The candidate demonstrates ownership, flexibility, and sound judgment while supporting a lean, fast-moving global team. What Will Make You Successful 
 Outstanding typography, layout, and information design skills. Strong visual judgment, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to design craftsmanship. Ability to create polished, production-ready work with minimal direction. Comfort moving quickly between projects while maintaining a consistently high quality bar. A practical understanding of how design supports brand perception, business goals, sales effectiveness, employee engagement, and client confidence. A collaborative, low-ego working style with the confidence to recommend stronger design solutions when needed. Strong organization, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment

title: Lead UI/UX Designer
description:
As the UX Lead for our ServiceNow platform, you will drive consistency across our UX and UI, document and ownthe standards that get us there, and build the design system and practice that make great experiences repeatable
rather than accidental. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the design direction and build it, in UI Builderand in React. 
This is a pivotal moment for experience on our platform. We are raising our ambition from enterprise tolerable toconsumer grade, moving beyond a traditional ITSM mindset to design solutions our users genuinely want to use.You will own the success and adoption of what we ship, not just the design behind it. You will establish a formal UX practice on the platform from the ground up and lead the designers and developers
who join it. Strong stakeholder management and communication are central to the role. You will be the advocatefor experience who aligns product, engineering, and business around a shared bar for quality, and holds us to it. What you will do
UX Standards and Consistency
Own and document the UX and UI standards for the platform, and drive their adoption across every teambuilding on ServiceNow.
Build and own a design system and component library so that consistency is built in, not policed after the fact.
Establish design patterns, guidelines, and reusable components that raise the floor on every solution we ship.
Define what good looks like on the platform and hold teams to it through design reviews and clearstandards. Consumer Grade Experience and Adoption
Move the platform beyond a traditional ITSM mindset and design solutions where the experience is consumergrade.
Own the success and adoption of the solutions we ship. Define what adoption looks like, measure it, and use
it to drive design decisions.
Partner with product and business teams to make sure we are solving the real user problem, not justdelivering the requested feature.
Bring an outside-in view of quality, benchmarked against the consumer products our users actually compareus to. 
Hands On Design and Build
Design and build experiences directly in UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework.
Write front-end code in React to build components, prototypes, and production experiences where nativetooling is not enough.
Move fluidly between design and implementation so that what gets shipped matches what was designed.
Set front-end engineering standards for the UX work on the platform. User Research and Accessibility
Stand up a user research practice. Talk to real users, run usability testing, and bring evidence to designdecisions rather than opinion.
Own accessibility on the platform. Make sure what we build meets WCAG standards and works for everyone, and build accessibility into the design system rather than retrofitting it.
Turn research and accessibility from checkboxes into a genuine part of how the team works. Mobile Experience
Extend the same consumer grade bar to mobile. Our mobile experience is a strength today and this role keepsit that way as the platform grows.
Design and build mobile experiences that are first class, not afterthoughts, across ServiceNow mobile appsand mobile web. Building the UX Practice and Team
Establish a formal UX practice on the platform from scratch: the standards, the tools, the rituals, and the waysof working.
Hire, lead, and grow a team of UX designers and developers, and build a culture where craft and userobsession are the norm.
Mentor the team and raise the level of design and front-end work across everyone building on the platform. Stakeholder Management and Communication
Be the advocate for experience across product, engineering, operations, and business, and align them arounda shared bar for quality.
Communicate design decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executiveleadership, and bring people along rather than mandating.
Make the case for investment in UX and show the return through adoption and outcomes. Minimum Qualifications
Deep hands on experience with ServiceNow native UX capabilities, including UI Builder and the NowExperience Framework, across workspaces, portals, and Employee Center.
Hands on front-end development experience with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with the ability to buildproduction experiences directly.
Proven track record building and owning a design system and component library adopted across multipleteams.
Experience establishing and documenting UX and UI standards and driving their adoption at scale.
Hands on user research experience, including usability testing and translating findings into design decisions.
Strong accessibility expertise, including WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 and designing for assistive technologies.
A portfolio that shows consumer grade enterprise experiences, and the judgment to move a platform beyondlegacy and ITSM era patterns.
Proven people leadership. You have built or led a team of designers and developers.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including with executive leadership.
Experience owning the adoption and success of what you ship, and measuring it.
Proficiency with Figma or equivalent design and prototyping tools.
8+ years in UX and UI design, with meaningful time in a lead or player-coach capacity. Preferred Qualifications
ServiceNow certifications related to UX, UI Builder, or application development (e.g., CSA, CAD).
Hands on experience with ServiceNow mobile, including Now Mobile and the mobile app builder.
Experience standing up a UX or design ops practice inside an organization that previously had none.
Experience turning around the reputation of a platform or product that had outgrown its original design.
Familiarity with Employee Center Pro intranet and portal experiences.
Experience with design system tooling such as Storybook, design tokens, and component documentation.
Interaction and motion design skills, and UX writing or content design experience.
Experience working with large scale enterprise design systems.

title: Graphic Designer & Video Production & Editing
description:
Graphic Designer & Video Editor Creative Content Company: Yaanendriya Private Limited
 Location: Peenya, Bengaluru
 Work Mode: On-site
 Function: Marketing / Creative / Brand About the Role Yaanendriya is looking for a creative professional who can work across Graphic Design and Video Production & Editing . This is not a conventional graphic-design role. You will be working closely with teams building products in sensors, robotics, drones, autonomous systems and deep-tech engineering — translating exciting technologies into strong visual stories. Your work could involve anything from creating a brochure for a new sensor or flight controller, shooting a drone or robotic platform in action, developing product-launch creatives, creating technical explainers, or editing videos demonstrating how our technology works in the real world. The person will be responsible for creating high-quality visual content for our products, brand, digital channels, exhibitions, customer communication and marketing initiatives. We are specifically looking for someone who is comfortable moving between Adobe design tools, brochures and marketing creatives on one side, and video shooting, editing and post-production on the other . What You Will Get to Work On You will create content around technologies and applications such as: Sensors and inertial navigation systems Robotics and autonomous systems Drones and UAVs Flight controllers and navigation electronics Unmanned ground vehicles Unmanned underwater vehicles Electronics and embedded systems Product testing, demonstrations and engineering development New deep-tech products being taken from development to market The role provides an opportunity to work closely with engineers and product teams and see real hardware, prototypes, robots, drones and autonomous systems being built and tested . Key Responsibilities Graphic Design Design brochures, flyers, standees, posters, banners and other marketing collateral. Create product visuals, social media creatives, website graphics and digital campaign assets. Develop layouts for technical and product brochures while maintaining strong visual hierarchy and brand consistency. Convert complex technical information into simple and visually compelling communication. Create graphics around sensors, robotics, drones and autonomous-system applications. Prepare print-ready files for exhibitions, events and marketing materials. Create presentations and visual communication material for product launches and customer interactions. Work with product photographs, renders and technical information to create visually engaging communication. Resize, adapt and optimize creatives for different digital and print formats. Video Production & Editing Plan and produce product videos, demonstrations, explainers, interviews, event videos and social media content. Shoot products, prototypes, robots, drones and demonstrations when required. Capture engineering and product-development stories in an engaging visual format. Handle the complete video editing workflow including: Video cutting and sequencing Colour correction / grading Audio correction and mixing Titles and typography Transitions Motion graphics Subtitles and captions Basic animation Convert technical and product information into engaging short-form and long-form videos. Create content suitable for LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, websites, exhibitions and customer presentations. Manage footage, project files and final video assets systematically. Required Skills Strong working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop Strong working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro Good knowledge of Adobe After Effects Good understanding of typography, layout, colour, composition and visual storytelling. Strong video editing and post-production skills. Ability to work with both horizontal and vertical video formats. Understanding of social-media video formats, resolutions and export settings. Ability to independently take a creative requirement from concept to final output. Video Shooting Skills Candidates who can independently handle video production/shooting in addition to editing will be strongly preferred . Knowledge of the following would be valuable: Camera operation Lighting Shot composition Product videography Drone and robotics videography Interview/video shoot setups Basic audio recording Product photography Good to Have Motion graphics and animation skills. Interest in technology, engineering, robotics, drones, automobiles or electronics. Experience creating content for technology, electronics, robotics, drones, automotive, industrial or engineering products. Photography and photo-retouching skills. Experience with DaVinci Resolve, Blender or other 3D/animation tools. Ability to create technical illustrations or infographics. Basic understanding of YouTube and social-media content production. Experience working with printers, production agencies or exhibition vendors. Who We Are Looking For Someone who: Is genuinely curious about technology and how things work . Gets excited about working around sensors, robots, drones, electronics and new engineering products. Has a strong visual sense and attention to detail. Can think creatively rather than simply execute templates. Is equally comfortable designing a brochure and editing a product video. Can understand a technical product and convert it into simple, visually compelling communication. Can independently own creative assignments from brief to final delivery. Is willing to shoot content at the office, testing locations, customer locations, exhibitions or events when required. Can work closely with engineering, product and marketing teams. Qualification & Experience Degree/Diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Animation, Film/Video Production or a related field preferred. 1–4 years of relevant experience preferred. Candidates with less experience but an exceptional portfolio may also apply. Portfolio Requirement Portfolio is mandatory. Applicants should preferably share examples of both: Graphic design work – brochures, posters, social media creatives, branding, presentations, etc. Video work – edited videos, product videos, reels, interviews, explainers, motion graphics, etc. Applications demonstrating capability in both graphic design and video production/editing will be preferred. Candidates with a genuine interest in drones, robotics, sensors, electronics and deep-tech products are particularly encouraged to apply. Role & responsibilities

title: Motion & Illustration Designer - Product| 3-5 yrs exp | Bangalore |
description:
Were looking for a Motion & Illustration Designer to join our Product Design team and help us create engaging, intuitive, and delightful product experiences. 
 The Role : 
As a Motion & Illustration Designer within the Product Design team, you will work closely with Product Designers, Product Managers, and Engineers to bring product experiences to life through motion, illustration, animation, and visual storytelling. You will play a key role in making products more expressive and intuitive from micro-interactions and onboarding experiences to illustrations, empty states, feature education, and complex product flows. Were looking for someone who understands that motion and illustration are not just decorative elements, but powerful tools to communicate, guide, simplify, and enhance the user experience.
 What Youll Do 
 Partner closely with Product Designers and Product Managers from the early stages of product discovery and ideation.
 Create motion concepts, animations, and micro-interactions for consumer and supply products.
 Bring UI designs to life through meaningful transitions, interactions, feedback states, and animations.
 Create illustrations, icons, characters, and visual assets for product experiences.
 Design illustrations and motion for onboarding, empty states, error states, success states, feature discovery, education, and engagement.
 Develop visual solutions for complex product problems and make them easier for users to understand.
 Create motion prototypes to help Product Designers communicate interaction ideas before development.
 Collaborate with Engineers to ensure animations and interactions are implemented effectively and maintain design intent.
 Build and maintain reusable motion and illustration components, patterns, and guidelines for the Product Design team.
 Explore new interaction and visual design patterns that can improve the overall product experience.
 Participate in design critiques and contribute to raising the motion, illustration, and visual craft bar across the Product Design team.
 Balance creativity with product constraints, usability, performance, and technical feasibility.
 What Were Looking For 
 3-5 years of experience in Motion Design, Product Design, Visual Design, Illustration, or a related field.
 Strong portfolio demonstrating motion + illustration work specifically for digital products/apps.
 Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, interaction design, visual hierarchy, composition, typography, and storytelling.
 Strong illustration skills with the ability to develop original visual styles and assets.
 Experience designing micro-interactions, UI animations, transitions, and product motion.
 Proficiency in tools such as Figma, After Effects, Illustrator, or equivalent tools.
 Experience collaborating closely with Product Designers and Engineers.
 Ability to think beyond individual screens and understand how motion and illustration contribute to the overall product experience.
 Strong attention to detail and a high bar for craft.
 Ability to take an ambiguous product problem and translate it into a clear visual or motion solution.
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative product environment.
 Good to Have 
 Experience with Lottie, Rive, ProtoPie, Principle, or similar interaction/motion tools.
 Experience creating animations for mobile applications.
 Understanding of motion performance and implementation constraints on mobile/web.
 Experience with design systems and reusable motion/visual components.
 Basic knowledge of 3D or character animation.
 Experience working in a consumer-tech or product startup. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Motion becomes a meaningful part of product experience, not just an embellishment.
 Users understand complex product flows faster through visual storytelling and motion.
 We develops a distinctive and consistent illustration and motion language across its products.
 Product Designers are able to prototype and communicate richer interactions effectively.
 The quality and craft of motion, illustration, and interaction design across the Product Design team continues to improve.
 Who Youll Work With 
Youll be part of the Product Design team and work closely with:
Product Designers Product Managers Engineers Research & Data teams Your primary focus will be on product experiences, with occasional collaboration with Brand/Marketing when product-led visual assets are required.
 What We Value 
Craft. Curiosity. Product thinking. Attention to detail. Experimentation.
Were looking for someone who can combine the craft of an illustrator and motion designer with the mindset of a product designer.

description:
Job Title Manager - Architecture/Interior Design (Hospitality) - Bangalore Job Description Summary Join our team as a Manager Architecture/Interior Designer, where you''ll bring your experience and creative expertise to design and execute projects that transform corporate spaces into functional, innovative, and visually appealing environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to the growth of the overall team. Job Description About the Role Lead the design process along with the senior designers, for corporate interior projects, from concept development to project completion, ensuring alignment with client objectives, brand identity, and design standards. Work with senior designers and clients to understand their needs, goals, and functional requirements, translating them into compelling design solutions. Develop comprehensive design concepts, mood boards, space plans, and 3D visualizations that effectively communicate design intent to clients and project teams. Lead the selection of furniture, fixtures, materials, finishes, and lighting to meet design goals, budget considerations, and project timelines. Creating design documentation, including detailed drawings, specifications, and construction documents. Oversee and guide junior designers in drawing documentation, including detailed drawings, specifications, and construction documents. Participate in client presentations, effectively conveying design concepts and incorporating feedback to refine and enhance designs. Collaborate with external partners, including contractors, vendors, and suppliers, to ensure seamless execution of design concepts during the construction and installation phases. Conduct on-site visits to monitor project progress, ensure adherence to design intent, and address any design-related challenges that may arise. Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and sustainable design practices, infusing innovative ideas into project work. Assist in managing project budgets and timelines, making informed decisions to balance design quality and project constraints. Uphold knowledge of building codes, regulations, accessibility standards, and health and safety requirements in design execution. Contribute to the development of proposals, presentations, and client pitches for new projects, showcasing the firm''s capabilities and design expertise. About You: Bachelor''s degree in Architecture or a related field; Master''s degree is a plus. 8+ years of experience in hotel/hospitality interior design, with a proven track record of leading successful projects. Proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, Photoshop, and Microsoft office suite. Experience using AI tools is a bonus. Strong conceptual thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex ideas into compelling design solutions. Excellent communication and presentation skills, enabling effective interaction with clients, project teams, and stakeholders. Portfolio showcasing a range of completed corporate interior design projects that highlight your design approach, creativity, and attention to detail. Familiarity with sustainable design principles and LEED certification is advantageous. Familiarity with wellbeing in design principles and WELL certification is advantageous. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high-quality design standards. Project management skills, scheduling, and risk assessment. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program. title: Head - Technical Designer
description:
Who We Are Space Matrix is a leading Workplace Design and Build’ consultancy that specializes in creating innovative, sustainable, and human-centric work environments. SMG aims to revolutionise the interior design industry by pioneering DesignTech and offering innovative interior design and building design solutions that cater to the workplace, hospitality, residential, and commercial sectors. Established in 2001 and headquartered in Singapore, we have a strong presence across APAC and beyond, we have more than 600 employees across 16 offices. We are a proud Great Place to Work certified company 7 years in a row. Please visit www.spacematrix.com to learn more. About the Role: SpaceMatrix delivers commercial, workplace and hospitality interiors across six regions. Design intent is strong and consistently solid; what varies is the technical layer beneath it — the depth of the drawing set, the resolution of junction details, the discipline of MEP coordination, and the quality of what finally gets built. That variance is regional, it is visible to clients, and it is the single largest source of avoidable cost, delay and reputational risk in the business. This role exists to remove that variance and to lead the technical function strategically. They own the firm and its documentation and detailing standard as a single national instrument, hold all six regions accountable to it, and carry personal technical responsibility for delivery on the practice & most demanding projects. Equally, this is a leadership appointment rather than a custodial one. The expectation is not only that our documentation becomes consistent, but that the way we produce it gets fundamentally better — that the person in this seat interrogates how drawings, details and coordination actually move through the practice, and redesigns that flow so technical quality and delivery speed improve together rather than trade against each other. This is a people-leadership appointment, not a senior individual-contributor seat. The work is done through teams— a central technical group reporting directly, and documentation leads in every region. Success is measured by the capability of those teams and the consistency of what they produce, not by the drawings this person produces personally. The benchmark is explicit: hospitality-level precision, applied to every typology we deliver. Not hospitality as a sector — hospitality as a standard of resolution, tolerance and finish. What makes the role successful: 1) Ownership of the National Documentation Standard Author, publish and maintain a single firm-wide DD& standard covering drawing hierarchy, sheet naming and numbering, scale conventions, layer and view templates, annotation and dimensioning protocol, revision control, and the mandatory deliverable schedule at each design stage. Build and own a central detail library — wet-area and dry-area junctions, skirting and shadow-gap conditions,ceiling perimeter and service integration details, flooring transitions, door and frame interfaces, joinery sections, expansion and movement joints, waterproofing terminations. Maintain a national Revit template and family standard, with model integrity rules, worksharing protocol and export conventions. Governance of the model is part of the standard, not separate from it. Publish specification templates and a controlled materials and finishes register, aligned to approved vendors and tested against Indian site availability, lead times and workmanship reality. Version, date, communicate and enforce every revision to the standard. The standard is a living document under a single custodian — this role. 2) Process Strategy and Delivery Flow Own the technical delivery process end to end and continuously improve it. The standard is the instrument; the objective is a faster, cleaner, more predictable path from concept sign-off to handover. Map the current documentation workflow across all six regions, identify where effort is duplicated, where information is lost between stages, and where late decisions are structurally forced — then redesign the sequence to remove those points. Define the stage-gate architecture for the practice: what must be frozen when, what deliverable closes each gate, and what downstream work is not permitted to begin until it does. Most programme loss originates in gates that were never enforced. Analyze defect, RFI, revision and rework data to locate root causes in process rather than in individuals, and to direct improvement effort where it returns the most. Evaluate and introduce technology that changes the economics of documentation — model-based quantity extraction, automated sheet and schedule generation, parametric detail families, clash-detection workflows, common data environments and issue-tracking platforms. Build the business case, pilot it, and roll it out with training rather than mandate. Work with design, project management and commercial leadership to align documentation effort with fee structure and resourcing, so technical rigour is planned and paid for rather than absorbed at the back end of a programme. Set the three-year technical roadmap for the practice and report progress against it to leadership. 3) Regional Accountability and Compliance Establish a documentation audit regime across all six regions: scheduled stage-gate reviews at concept sign-off, DD freeze, GFC release and pre-handover, with written findings and closure tracking. Hold release authority over the GFC set. No drawing package issues to a contractor from any region without technical clearance against the standard. Report compliance by region to the leadership group on a defined cycle, with defect trends, repeat findings and remediation status. Non-compliance is escalated, not absorbed. Identify and close capability gaps region by region — through training, template correction, resourcing recommendations or, where necessary, direct intervention on the project. Standardise the technical interface with clients and PMCs: RFI formats, submittal registers, material approval workflows, snag list structure and handover documentation. 4) Project Delivery — Technical Leadership Carry accountability for technical delivery on the practice's flagship and highest-risk projects — directing the teams producing the work, not producing it personally. Review, interrogate and sign off the full drawing set: dimensioned layouts, RCPs, elevations, sections, joinery and bespoke element details, finishes and door schedules, setting-out and coordination drawings. Judgement and approval sits here; authorship sits with the team. Direct BOQ preparation and defend it commercially — setting the specification position, scrutinising rates,and holding the line against unapproved substitution at award and at site. Ensure design is reconciled against programme, budget and buildability before it reaches the contractor, and intervene personally where a project is failing or a client relationship requires seniority. 5) MEP and Services Coordination Own services coordination as a design discipline. Lead ceiling void reconciliation, clear-height verification,service routing, and clash resolution with MEP consultants, PMCs and specialist contractors. Set the coordination protocol every region follows: coordination sequence, model federation, clash tolerance, sign-off gates and the point at which ceiling design is frozen. Verify sprinkler, diffuser, detector, luminaire, speaker and access-panel layouts against the reflected ceiling design — symmetry, alignment and setting-out treated as design deliverables, not contractor discretion. Protect committed ceiling heights and clear dimensions through the coordination process. Where they cannot be held, raise it early and in writing. 6) Site Quality, Mockups and Handover Set and enforce a national QC protocol: mockup and benchmark approval before bulk execution, stage inspections, material sign-off at delivery, and workmanship tolerances published in millimetres. Run and standardise the snagging process — structured snag registers, categorised defects, closure evidence,and a de-snag sign-off that is genuinely conditional. Attend sites across regions at the stages that decide quality: setting out, first fix, ceiling grid, mockup, and pre-handover. Own post-occupancy technical review — capture defects and failures back into the detail library so the same mistake is not detailed twice. 7) People Leadership and Capability Lead the central technical and standards team directly — objective-setting, workload allocation, performance review, development planning and day-to-day management. Lead the documentation leads across all six regions through a matrix relationship: set their technical objectives, contribute formally to their appraisals, and hold them accountable for regional compliance. Own technical hiring for the practice — define competency benchmarks for documentation roles, set the assessment method, and sit on selection panels across regions. Run a structured technical training programme: detailing workshops, MEP literacy sessions, BOQ writing, site exposure and Revit standards training, with defined progression from junior to senior documentation capability. Mentor senior technical staff towards independent compliance, so the standard is upheld locally rather than policed centrally — and build a succession bench beneath this role. Manage underperformance where it persists, and make the resourcing and structural recommendations required when a region cannot meet the standard with its current team. Advise leadership on technical headcount, team structure and resourcing across the six regions. The Precision Benchmark: “Hospitality-level precision” is a measurable standard, not an aspiration. In this role it means: Every junction is drawn, not assumed. Where two materials meet, a detail exists at an appropriate scale and it is the contractor & only instruction. Setting-out is designed. Tile, panel, joint and ceiling grids are set out from a stated datum with cut positions decided by the designer, not the mason. Tolerances are published. Level, plumb, alignment, joint width and reveal dimensions carry stated tolerances in millimetres, and they are inspected against. Services are composed. Every visible ceiling and wall element is positioned deliberately and coordinated to the design grid. Specification is unambiguous. A specification names the product, the standard, the finish, the substrate, the fixing and the acceptance criterion. Mockups precede bulk. Nothing repetitive or high-visibility proceeds without an approved benchmark. Documentation is traceable. Every revision is recorded, reasoned and issued through a controlled register. Authority: For this role to function, the following authority is delegated and must be stated in the appointment letter: Technical release authority over GFC drawing packages in all six regions. Authority to reject non-compliant documentation and to stop issues until corrected. Authority to halt bulk execution at site pending mockup or benchmark approval. Custodianship of the national standard, detail library, Revit template and approved materials register — sole rights of amendment. Formal input into the objectives, appraisals and progression of documentation staff in every region. Decision rights on technical hiring standards and on selection for documentation roles practice-wide. Escalation path direct to the Managing Director on unresolved regional non-compliance. What We’re Looking For: Bachelor's degree in Interior Design or Architecture from a recognised institution. 8–14 years in interior fitout delivery, with a minimum of five full projects taken personally from design development through GFC, construction support and handover. Demonstrable hospitality or luxury-residential documentation experience, or equivalent evidence of detailing at that resolution in a commercial context. Advanced Revit — model authoring, family creation, template and worksharing management, and the ability to set standards others work to. AutoCAD proficiency assumed. Genuine MEP literacy: able to read service drawings, identify clashes independently, and hold a technical argument with an HVAC, fire or electrical consultant on merit. BOQ authorship and specification writing from first principles, including rate scrutiny and tender-stage negotiation. Working command of NBC, applicable fire and life-safety requirements, local statutory approvals and the compliance conditions that govern occupancy. Demonstrated line-management experience — a team of at least six to eight technical staff, with direct responsibility for hiring, appraisal, development and performance management. Experience leading through influence across geographies, including staff who did not report to you directly. Evidence of having improved a delivery process, not merely operated within one — a workflow redesigned, a stage-gate structure introduced, a technology adopted, with a stated before-and-after effect. Experience working across multiple offices, cities or teams, with evidence of having imposed consistency across them. Willingness and availability to travel nationally at short notice. Preferred Prior experience authoring or owning a firm-wide design standard, detail library or documentation manual. Exposure to international hospitality operator standards and brand technical guidelines. Experience on the contractor or PMC side, or in design-and-build delivery. Competencies and Disposition: People's leadership. Builds technical capability in others and is measured by it. Comfortable setting objectives, giving difficult feedback, developing successors and managing underperformance through to resolution. Technical authority. Credibility rests on demonstrated command of the detail, not position alone. This A person will be challenged by regional leads and by contractors, and must win on substance — while resisting the pull to take the work back and do it themselves. Constructive obstinacy. Able to hold a standard under commercial and programme pressure, and to say no at site at eight in the evening. Strategic ownership. Think about documentation as a production system with cost, cycle time and failure rates, not as a set of drawings. Can articulate a three-year technical direction for the practice and sequence it against commercial reality. Systems thinking. Treats a recurring defect as a documentation failure to be fixed at source, not a site problem to be resolved individually. Influence without direct line authority. Regional teams report elsewhere. Compliance has to be achieved through credibility, clarity and consistency as much as through mandate. Written precision. Standards, audit findings and specifications are written instruments. Ambiguity in writing becomes a defect on site. What This Role Is Not: This is not a concept design or visualisation role. It sits downstream of design ideation and is measured on buildability, coordination and executed quality. Candidates whose portfolios comprise renders and mood boards without complete drawing sets, BOQs and executed site evidence will not be shortlisted. It is also not a senior individual-contributor position. The practice already has capable technical people producing drawings; what it needs is someone to lead them. A candidate whose satisfaction comes primarily from personally authoring the set, and who is reluctant to delegate, will neither enjoy this role nor succeed in it. Nor is it a passive standards or documentation-control function. The role carries live project accountability and real authority, over both work and people, and requires someone prepared to use it.
